test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Avika hopes getting a distinction in English.
solution:
The erroneous part is** getting i.e. this part has an error.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Change **getting **with **to get**.
 
• There are some verbs that are always followed by infinitive 'To' i.e**. Hope, Get, Fail, Seek, T**hreatened,** etc.**
 
 
• She **threatened** to quit if she didn't get a raise.​
 
 
 
• Hence, **To get** is the correct form to be used here after '**hope'**.

 

**The correct sentence is**: Avika hopes **to get** a distinction in English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Common verbs followed by a gerund:**__

 
• **Admit: **He admitted cheating on the test.
 
• **Deny: **He denied committing the crime.
 
• **Despise: **She despises waking up early.
 
• **Discuss: **We discussed working at the company.
 
• **Dislike: **She dislikes working after 5 PM.
